summary: The exact candidate removes Gemma4's quadratic dense custom-mask construction, replaces it with O(number of images) span metadata, evaluates causal-or-same-image in both Triton extend kernels, and supplies spans only to sliding-attention layers. The base fails the candidate metadata regression; the candidate passes its regressions and an independent finite-window GPU adversarial case against a dense PyTorch reference.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before reproduction: both tests failed because compact image-span metadata was absent on the recorded base. The base implementation still constructs and installs the dense custom mask.
Two candidate metadata tests passed, covering compact span contents, mixed batches, split-image causal fallback, and sliding-only layer routing.
Both modified Triton kernels matched an independent dense PyTorch attention reference on gfx950 for batching, prefixes, multiple images, block-crossing spans, and a request-boundary span.

Independent adversarial modification passed both Triton kernels against the dense reference with a finite 127-token sliding window, a single-token span, a span beginning at the prefix boundary, and spans crossing query-block boundaries.

The issue-specific test and ten other tests passed. Three existing/general gfx950 checks failed: a large-attention tolerance, a block-size expectation mismatch, and one unified-versus-regular tolerance case. These match the candidate report and are not introduced by the image-span paths.

gpu_evidence: Both changed Triton kernels executed on the assigned AMD Instinct MI355X (gfx950) with torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 and matched independent dense PyTorch references in the candidate and adversarial cases.
remaining_limitations: Gemma4 E4B weights were unavailable, so no full-model semantic/quality or TTFT reproduction was performed.

The original NVIDIA H20 and DGX Spark performance measurements could not be repeated on this AMD gfx950 host; review evidence establishes removal of the quadratic representation and kernel numerical correctness, not those exact speedups.
No native rebuild was required: all candidate runtime changes are checkout-local Python and Triton JIT source, and imports were confirmed to resolve to /job/repo.
The full Triton attention test file has three ambient gfx950 failures documented in raw/full_kernel_file.log.
